description: Saves an instrument model that you drafted from a page of the instrument's manual the user pasted, into the user's Moontide data folder (models/<id>.json), never into Moontide itself. First call it with confirmed: false: it checks the model and returns a summary (channels, sounds with their program numbers as sent and as numbered in a manual from 1, controls, reset bytes, notes) and saves nothing. Show that summary to the user, and call it again with the same model and confirmed: true only after they say yes. It refuses an id of a model Moontide ships, and an existing model unless overwrite is true. Fields: id (lowercase letters, digits, dashes or underscores, at most 32), name, channels { melodic, rhythm } (lists of channels 1-16), bankSelect (none, msb or msb-lsb), rhythmBank (optional: true when the instrument chooses drum kits by bank select and program change; every rhythm sound then needs a bank), drumMaps (optional, at most 8: [{ id, name, notes: [{ note 0-127, name }] }] typed from the instrument's manual), drumMap (optional: the id of the map of kits without their own; general-midi is built in), a rhythm sound's noteMap (optional: a map id, or null when no map is known for that kit), defaultVolume (0-127), clock (optional: true when the instrument follows MIDI clock, so Moontide sends it the clock, Start and Stop), reset (optional: sysex with at most 4 messages, each { kind: roland-dt1, model, address, data } as hex bytes or { kind: raw, bytes } from F0 to F7 and at most 32 bytes, and waitMs), controls ([{ id, name, cc, min, max, default }]), sounds { melodic, rhythm } ([{ name, program 0-127 as sent, bank { msb, lsb } when the instrument needs one }]) and notes (facts about the instrument, at most 10).

confirmed.description: false to check and summarize without saving; true only after the user said yes to the summary

model.description: The drafted model, as a JSON object

overwrite.description: true to replace an existing user model with the same id

name: save_midi_model
